newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon foreign debt up $35 million in September.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon foreign debt up $35 million in September.

text.p: Lebanon's foreign debt rose $35 million in September to $1,592 million from $1,557 million in August, the Governor of the Bank of Lebanon Riad Salameh said in remarks published on Friday.
The foreign debt stood at nearly $1,312.6 million in December 1995.
"This debt is probably the lowest of all foreign debts of the countries in the region," Salameh told the Beirut French-Speaking magazine Le Commerce Du Levant.
